title: The 3 Best Cat Litter Boxes Under $80 in 2026
h1: The 3 Best Cat Litter Boxes Under $80 in 2026
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for cat litter boxes under $80 in 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at cat litter boxes under $80 in 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: IRIS USA Premium Top Entry Litter Box
products.blurb: Key specs: Large square top-entry design, Privacy walls, Litter particle catching lid.
strengths: Large square footprint gives bigger cats real room to turn around and dig
limitations: Fully manual, still requires daily scooping
No built-in liner or filter system, owners supply their own litter and liners
Top-entry mode isn't ideal for kittens or mobility-limited cats

products.name: Amazon Basics Nonstick Top-Entry Cat Litter Box with Filter Lid, Large
strengths: Grated lid catches litter from paws
Tall walls stop kicked litter and deter dogs
Nonstick interior is easier to scoop
limitations: Not suitable for senior or arthritic cats
Large kittens may struggle to jump in

products.name: Amazon Basics Large High-Sided Open Cat Litter Box with Scoop
strengths: Lowered front suits older and large cats
limitations: Some litter still scatters from the front
